column2: (3)  A  person  whose  name  is  entered  in  the    Register
be  eligible  to  hold  office  as  a  Homoeopathic
physician or any other office in Government or in
any  institution  maintained  by  a  local  or  other
be eligible to give any evidence at any inquest or
any  Court  as  an  expert  under  the  Evidence
Ordinance on any matter relating to Homoeopathy.
